exposure: occurrence of atopic dermatitis before food allergy onset
symptoms occurrence after ingestion of specific food
cohort: Six hundred and twenty-seven pediatric subjects aged 0-14 years with suspected food allergy were prospectively evaluated at a tertiary center.
finding: The study successfully developed two models (NAPFA score, M1 and M2) with high c-statistics (0.915 for M1, 0.977 for M2) that can predict the probability of food allergy in children, offering a potential tool to streamline diagnosis.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a significant predictor in one of the diagnostic models (M1) for estimating the probability of having food allergy.
country: Italy (inferred from 'Naples Pediatric Food Allergy score')
